regime_title: Regulatory Clarity vs. Fed Rate Uncertainty
summary: The market is caught between significant regulatory advancements (SEC/OCC) and persistent uncertainty regarding the Federal Reserve's interest rate path.

key_drivers.title: Federal Reserve Policy & Macro Headwinds
key_drivers.description: Focus remains on inflation control and growth restraint, with hawkish sentiment suggesting potential rate hikes or sustained high rates (Hammack/WSJ).

key_drivers.title: Regulatory Infrastructure Buildout
key_drivers.description: The SEC is actively advancing rules for 24/7 trading and clearing crypto assets, while the OCC facilitates banking integration, signaling institutional adoption.

key_drivers.title: Institutional Access & Political Support
key_drivers.description: High-level political engagement (White House) combined with specific industry filings (Knicks/NBA) suggests strong capital flow and mainstream acceptance.

invalidation_triggers: A sudden, aggressive dovish pivot from the Fed that devalues risk assets.
Regulatory fragmentation or conflicting rulings among SEC, OCC, and state bodies.
Significant geopolitical shock leading to flight-to-safety assets (e.g., gold/Treasuries) over crypto.
